purpose: Keep external thinkers, rival models, mathematical families, tools, existing simulations, and product tests visible without installing any of them as Ratchet canon.

governance.ratchet_role: hypothesis-agnostic comparison, defect discovery, minimal refinement, retained history, and Purgatory receipts
governance.owner_hypotheses_role: explicit proposals that may guide bounded exploration but cannot preselect a result
governance.external_import_role: instrument, rival, construction source, benchmark, or criticism to test rather than an authority
governance.admission_rule: Every entry needs a concrete operational contribution, a stated assumption boundary, a runnable or formal test, and a pass/fail/HOLD/Purgatory receipt before it can affect a claim path.

initial_entries.name: three-engine finite probe quotient
initial_entries.kind: existing executable source and math calibration
initial_entries.possible_contribution: Operational equivalence/refinement surface; proves a concrete source table can change root-Ratchet admissibility.
initial_entries.assumptions_to_expose: Finite opaque support and chosen probe table; no carrier ontology or object claim.
initial_entries.rival_or_control: erased-versus-full probe table; exact Julia/JAX/PyTorch agreement; source tamper rejection
initial_entries.test_or_receipt_needed: included replay receipt and future successor-compiler controls
